reviews.title: 9070XT is worth the upgrade!
reviews.comment: This graphics card has performed way above what I thought! I haven’t even over locked it! Compared to my old 6750XT, this is leagues better. Not to mention, I got this in two days rather than the three weeks it estimated. The graphics quality is amazing! The fans are super quiet. The cpu/gpu monitors show this card runs pretty cool. Overall, amazing product! And it matches my white case!
reviews.author: Aaron Harmeyer

reviews.title: Amazing Mid-Range GPU
reviews.comment: The performance is great for a mid range card as it consistently gets up to 2k 180 fps on games that the devs bothered to optimize properly. Temp rarely gets above 70°C even after hours of gaming. In terms of noise, there's a bit of coil whine under high loads, but in my experience, it'll be drowned out by the noise of the game you're playing. It's an excellent card for a mid range build, but keep in mind you are paying a premium because this is a special model.
